findings.evidence: `code/lake-manifest.json:8` pins Mathlib at `58e016c6f6c829b5f25b1a87a88f495f40e70aa7`; `rg MATHLIB_CACHE_DEBUG_USE_LEGACY mathlib` returns no hits, while `mathlib/Cache/Requests.lean:298-312` documents and reads only `MATHLIB_CACHE_GET_URL`.
findings.fix: Merge the prerequisite pin change first, or explicitly document that the variable is ignored until that pin lands; likewise qualify the comments in `ci.yml`, `nightly-verify.yml`, `pages.yml`, `pr-build.yml`, and `pr-profile.yml`.
findings.issue: The document and all five workflow comments claim that setting `MATHLIB_CACHE_DEBUG_USE_LEGACY` redirects reads, but the PR-head Mathlib pin has no such variable, so operators are told a currently inert control works.

summary: The new operational documentation presents an escape hatch that the currently pinned cache tool does not implement.
